ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver, together. This dispute turns on one question: was the driver actually inside the pickup geofence at Tiong Bahru Plaza, holding position for the required five minutes, before he cancelled and the SGD 5.00 no-show fee was applied? I cannot decide that question on this record, and the policy sends it to a human reviewer.

WHAT IS ESTABLISHED. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00901, full weight 1.0) contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:43:00, no boarding event, and a driver-initiated cancellation at 08:51:00 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are therefore met (driver claims 1 and 4 accepted). The chat log (EV-CHAT-00901, full weight 1.0) contains only driver messages and the system notice; the rider posted nothing and did not answer the driver's 08:47:05 in-app call. POL-NS-04 consequently cannot exonerate the rider — limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from the rider and there is none, and limb (b) fails because a call was placed before termination (driver claim 5 accepted; rider claim 6 is right to abandon this route). Rider presence is undecidable under POL-NS-04(c) because no rider track was supplied (driver claim 6 accepted).

WHAT CANNOT BE DECIDED. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) must be proved from the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00901). That artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD — sampling gaps of up to 240 seconds inside the waiting window, fewer than six fixes across it, the rider track omitted, and no horizontal-accuracy figure on any of its eight fixes. Under POL-NS-02 a fix reporting no accuracy is evidence of neither presence nor absence, so not one fix establishes arrival. The test those limbs require therefore could not be run: limbs (b) and (c) are UNDECIDED over the waiting window, not failed. That disposes of the rider's refund arguments — the POL-NS-02 full-refund limb (claims 1 and 2) and the POL-NS-06 shortfall arithmetic (claim 3) both read 'no qualifying fix' as proof the driver never arrived, and a data gap cannot be read that way. It equally disposes of the driver's contrary argument (claims 3 and 10): the trip record's arrival marker is auto-confirmed from the same GPS measurement, so marker and trace are one carrier and not two, and the chat log is the driver's own account, which may not stand in for a measurement the test never admitted.

CONSEQUENCE. The fact that decides this dispute — the driver's in-geofence presence and dwell — is carried only by an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(b). POL-NS-08 therefore caps any monetary ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates the case under POL-NS-09; POL-NS-09(e) makes that escalation terminal, and POL-NS-09(a) applies independently because confidence is capped at 0.6, below the 0.70 floor. The SGD 5.00 is HELD — neither collected nor refunded — pending review.

ALSO FOR THE REVIEWER. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00901, weight 0.75, issue code PARTIAL_RECORD) charged SGD 5.00 where fee_schedule.resolution_rule yields SGD 4.00 for a STANDARD-zone RYDE_X trip; that is a POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect, and the cancellation-fee line should be reconciled to SGD 4.00 (rider claim 5 and driver claim 14 accepted on this point, though no money moves while the case is escalated).

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE HUMAN REVIEWER. Determine, from the raw telemetry behind the auto-arrival marker or otherwise, whether the driver was genuinely inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence and held the required 300-second dwell before cancelling. If he was not, the fee is refunded in full and the trip recorded accordingly; if he was, POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 govern. The reviewer receives both advocate briefs, the admissibility pre-pass report, the clause IDs relied on (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-04, POL-NS-06, POL-NS-07, POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09) and this reasoning.
